newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER FALL.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume fell at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 75 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from last Tuesday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 475 shares at the previous session on Thursday when only Alkaloid stocks traded at 1,000 and 970 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
